'''Juan Francisco Valero Cara''' (Juanfra Valero) was a Star Wars CCG tournament director in Granada, Spain. He posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list.<ref name="list-24187">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/24187.html? swccg-discussion message #24187], [[Juan Francisco Valero Cara]] (18 November 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108230422/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/24187.html? Internet Archive]</ref>
